acts: FDA prescribing information published on DailyMed

en.title: amoxicillin: Highlights, Dosage and Administration and 2.5 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: Highlights, Dosage and Administration reads “severe renal impairment (GFR greater than 30 mL/min)”. 2.5 reads “less than 30 mL/min”. Example: A patient with GFR 45 mL/min is in the reduced-dose group by Highlights and not by 2.5 and 8.6; a patient with GFR 10 mL/min is the reverse. The same text is in 180 labels from 34 labelers in the DailyMed release of 29 October 2026.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: medium. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
